title: Integrate European text substitution callback candidates
changes: Derive 75 candidate substitution indices from authenticated text and script-text programs, preserve their 300 callback-table bytes including four null words in text.catalogs, and leave unselected guest addresses and callback execution unchanged.
Publish the sparse projection in EUR e160-d159 and report typed substitution source use; keep earlier text catalog projections intact.
validation: Windows GNU build e160-substitution-build-_wiucz_6 and Wine unit e160-substitution-wine-2bltt60c passed e159 comparison, e160 creation/reuse, all poisoned-source bytes and boundary/raw fallback checks, source guards, and 18 original dispatcher-prefix state/clock comparisons.
The Wine server drained after a nonfatal D-Bus diagnostic. The current e160 dataset is retained by the validation unit.

Production Windows build e160-substitution-cli-build-v7ztnkqz and Wine unit e160-substitution-cli-wine-mgaon9d6 passed dataset creation, reuse and verification against all 104 tested files; the 11-frame world-map input read four indexed-graphics context bytes and zero substitution callback bytes.
limitations: Candidates do not prove parser reachability or safe callback invocation; generated dispatch may fall back to interpretation. Callback output, ordinary use, broader Wine regressions, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance measurement.
